# Project Observatory

The complete local observation engine for agent-operated projects, from
PassionCode.ai (https://passioncode.ai/) and part of the ssheleg harness. The local
dashboard speaks English by default and Russian by choice. Public code; per-user private configuration, project registry,
SQLite history and credentials. Includes CLI, local dashboards, MCP, metrics,
provider adapters and optional scheduler. Integrations are individually enabled.
The original portable 0.1 CLI remains available as a separate compatibility mode.

- Source: https://github.com/passioncode-ai/project-observatory-dashboard
- Onboarding: https://github.com/passioncode-ai/project-observatory-dashboard/blob/main/docs/ONBOARDING.md
- Compatibility: https://github.com/passioncode-ai/project-observatory-dashboard/blob/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md
- Security: https://github.com/passioncode-ai/project-observatory-dashboard/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- Field notes: https://observatory.sshlg.me/field-notes/
- PassionCode.ai: https://passioncode.ai/ (Switchboard: https://passioncode.ai/switchboard/)
- Skills: https://skills.sshlg.me/
- Harness: https://skills.sshlg.me/harness/

Historical case: 202 value-replacement events, 66 in claude-mem SQLite and 136 in
Chroma SQLite. These are not unique credentials, incidents or vendor vulnerabilities.
Known-value matching does not prove absence of other secrets or remote exfiltration.
Enter secrets locally, never in agent chat. Never publish the private dashboard.
